title: Project Coordinator – Machine Building (f/m/d)
description:
We build special machines for packaging and assembly lines. Our team works in German and English; English at B1 is sufficient for supplier contact.

What you'll do
- Coordinate schedules and milestones for customer orders
- Align engineering, purchasing and assembly
- Track costs and change requests in SAP
- Prepare status reports for customers and management

What you bring
- Technical degree or technician qualification
- 3+ years in project coordination in machine building
- MS Project and SAP
- German (native or C1) and basic English
